technical.summary: ABT shows long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA) but is caught in a short-term downtrend with multiple oversold indicators lacking bullish confirmation; price rejection below key moving averages and negative momentum divergence make this a poor swing entry despite oversold conditions.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear zone (40 VIX equivalent) with bearish sentiment (38.3%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and mixed congressional activity (one small sale, one medium purchase 77-98 days old) limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (299.84) dominates; normal yield curve and falling DXY provide limited offset; earnings in 13 days adds binary event risk to already hostile risk environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA 50/200 bullish structure and oversold RSI/Stochastic in fear-zone market create contrarian opportunity if support at 121.33 holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Active death cross, price rejection below all key moving averages, negative momentum (AO, CMF, OBV), zero fundamental conviction, imminent earnings binary event, and VIX crisis regime create a hostile setup that oversold conditions cannot justify.
